units: <cite ref="Gittin 83a:12">Gitt. 83ᵃ</cite> <he>כולהו אית להו פ׳ … דלית ליה פ׳</he> to all of them objections may be raised, except the opinion of R. E. which is unobjectionable.
<cite ref="Menachot 66a:15">Men. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>חזי ליה פ׳</he> saw an objection to it.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 130b:13">B. Bath. 130ᵇ</cite> <he>כי אתא … וחזיתו ביה פ׳</he> if a legal decision of mine comes before you, and you see in it something objectionable; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00874"><he>פִּירְכֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00347"><he>פִּרְ׳</he></cite>.
